title: Query probability under coordinate permutations
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates. For every permutation $\sigma$ of the coordinates and every coordinate $i$, the probability that the permuted tree queries $i$ under independent inputs with common distribution $\pi$ equals the probability that $T$ queries $\sigma^{-1}(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution $\pi$ on $\Omega$ is given
The input coordinates are independently distributed according to $\pi$
$T$ is a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates
A permutation $\sigma$ of the coordinates is chosen
